title: Food Cooking Machine Operators and Tenders
description: Operate or tend cooking equipment, such as steam cooking vats, deep fry cookers, pressure cookers, kettles, and boilers, to prepare food products.

tasks.text: Clean, wash, and sterilize equipment and cooking area, using water hoses, cleaning or sterilizing solutions, or rinses.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on cleaning of work areas

dwas.name: Clean work areas.
Sterilize food cooking or processing equipment.

tasks.text: Read work orders, recipes, or formulas to determine cooking times and temperatures, and ingredient specifications.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Parse specs and materials from orders

dwas.name: Read work orders or other instructions to determine product specifications or materials requirements.
Review blueprints or other instructions to determine operational methods or sequences.

tasks.text: Observe gauges, dials, and product characteristics, and adjust controls to maintain appropriate temperature, pressure, and flow of ingredients.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Instrument monitoring needs physical sensor presence

dwas.name: Monitor instruments to ensure proper production conditions.
Adjust equipment controls to regulate flow of production materials or products.

tasks.text: Measure or weigh ingredients, using scales or measuring containers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical measuring and dispensing of ingredients

dwas.name: Measure ingredients or substances to be used in production processes.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Tend or operate and control equipment, such as kettles, cookers, vats and tanks, and boilers, to cook ingredients or prepare products for further processing.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on cooking with heat and perishable materials

dwas.name: Operate cooking, baking, or other food preparation equipment.

tasks.text: Record production and test data, such as processing steps, temperature and steam readings, cooking time, batches processed, and test results.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

dwas.name: Record operational or production data.

tasks.text: Set temperature, pressure, and time controls, and start conveyers, machines, or pumps.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual temperature control adjustment

dwas.name: Adjust temperature controls of ovens or other heating equipment.
Operate pumping systems or equipment.

tasks.text: Remove cooked material or products from equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically extracting parts from production equipment

dwas.name: Remove products or workpieces from production equipment.

tasks.text: Collect and examine product samples during production to test them for quality, color, content, consistency, viscosity, acidity, or specific gravity.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Food product inspection is sensory and hands-on

dwas.name: Inspect food products.
Collect samples of materials or products for testing.

tasks.text: Pour, dump, or load prescribed quantities of ingredients or products into cooking equipment, manually or using a hoist.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Rigging and lifting loads with cranes is hands-on

dwas.name: Load materials into production equipment.
Lift materials or workpieces using cranes or other lifting equipment.

tasks.text: Listen for malfunction alarms, and shut down equipment and notify supervisors when necessary.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Notifying maintenance needs is routine messaging

dwas.name: Watch operating equipment to detect malfunctions.
Operate cooking, baking, or other food preparation equipment.
Notify others of equipment repair or maintenance needs.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Notify or signal other workers to operate equipment or when processing is complete.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Embodied signaling in shared physical workspace

dwas.name: Signal others to coordinate work activities.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Turn valves or start pumps to add ingredients or drain products from equipment and to transfer products for storage, cooling, or further processing.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on production flow control

dwas.name: Adjust equipment controls to regulate flow of production materials or products.

tasks.text: Admit required amounts of water, steam, cooking oils, or compressed air into equipment, such as by opening water valves to cool mixtures to the desired consistency.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical valve/control manipulation for coolant

dwas.name: Adjust equipment controls to regulate coolant flow.

tasks.text: Activate agitators and paddles to mix or stir ingredients, stopping machines when ingredients are thoroughly mixed.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on operation of mixing machinery

dwas.name: Operate mixing equipment.

tasks.text: Operate auxiliary machines and equipment, such as grinders, canners, and molding presses, to prepare or further process products.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Grinding requires hands-on control and feel

dwas.name: Operate grinding equipment.

tasks.text: Place products on conveyors or carts, and monitor product flow.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical moving of products between work areas

dwas.name: Move products, materials, or equipment between work areas.
